title: mixcore core API v0.3: result of Start

faderLaw.description: Which law FaderPosition/FaderDB implement. xair (v0.2) is the same four-segment law as x32, -inf..+10 dB (XA-F40), named after its family. wing (additive) draws the same four-segment scale; WING reads and writes faders in dB (-144 dB = -inf .. +10 dB, WG-F60), so this law only draws the scale and shapes gestures; the console's own raw law below -3 dB is unverified (WG-F61).

demo.description: v0.3 (additive), demo mixer: true when Start targeted the running demo mixer (StartDemo, demo.schema.json), which the core tells by family, host and port. Absent means a real console.
